entities.name: Bosco
entities.description: Ambitious floor mopper of the Orzhov guild.

entities.name: Drovo
entities.description: Guildless friend Bosco recruited and fed to a Crypt Ghast.

entities.name: Jozica
entities.description: Orzhov enforcer whose Dutiful Thrull demands a mopper tax.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: Ravnican guild of debt and power.

entities.name: High Prelate
entities.description: Orzhov official who gave Bosco his contract and mission.

entities.name: Crypt Ghast
entities.description: Dread spirit in the Orzhov mausoleum fed Drovo.

entities.name: Orzhov mausoleum
entities.description: Place beyond the Rogue's Passage containing two sarcophagi.

events.summary: Bosco recruits his friend Drovo to a mission, boasting of his debt and guild benefits.
events.quote: Bosco set about recruiting him to a mission.

events.summary: Bosco signs a new contract in the high prelate's office with Jozica, erasing years of debt and giving a promotion.
events.quote: signing a new contract that would erase years of his debt and give him a promotion

events.summary: Bosco leads Drovo into the Orzhov mausoleum and locks him in with the sarcophagi.
events.quote: Bosco locked the door behind Drovo and apologized to him.

events.summary: A Crypt Ghast rises from a sarcophagus and attacks Drovo.
events.quote: It smelled the blood on Drovo and attacked.

events.summary: Bosco reports success to the high prelate, is promoted to mission runner and no longer fears Jozica.
events.quote: Bosco had been promoted to a mission runner for the high prelate

relations.note: Floor mopper in debt to the guild.
relations.quote: Bosco is an ambitious floor mopper of the Orzhov guild.

relations.note: Promoted to mission runner for the high prelate.
relations.quote: Bosco had been promoted to a mission runner for the high prelate

relations.note: Betrayed his friend by feeding him to the ghast.
relations.quote: Bosco locked the door behind Drovo and apologized to him.
